Y1 is driven by a DOMINANT X3*X6 bilinear interaction (coeff≈0.949) plus a strong positive X5 effect (convex, range +0.184 at product=1.0 to +0.256 at product=0.72, with negative X5*product interaction ≈-0.286), plus small additive terms from X1, X2, X4 (each ~0.05 range). Y2 is reduced by X4(-0.200), X2(-0.153), X1(-0.094) and increased by X3*X6 interaction; X5 has near-zero effect at moderate product (-0.005) strengthening to -0.059 at product=1.0.
